intro.heading: Cheerful Nonsense.
intro.description:
Hi. I'm Zuocheng Wang.  I'm currently in University of Pittsburgh undergraduate program, majoring 'Computer Science' and 'Digital Narrative & Interactive Design'. I’d like to think of myself as someone with a broad range of interests. If you walked up to me and started talking about your hobbies, no matter what they are, I could probably hold my own in the conversation. 

I’ve always had a bone to pick with the Chinese public education system’s obsession with sorting people into "Arts vs. Sciences." It creates this false dichotomy, subtly erasing the possibility of being both. To me, art decides the destination, while technology decides how to get there; possessing both is the truly rare skill of our time. This isn't "distraction" or "unproductive." My enjoyment is my greatest priority.

As the headline says, "The world is a cheerful nonsense" (Hermann Hesse). There is no singular, noble "meaning" out there that demands we sacrifice infinite possibilities in our short lives. Look, the world is getting more beautiful by the second.

This page was originally intended to be a traditional CV. However, since the cool stuffs I made are already documented in their respective sections, and my formal academic information and technical history can be found in my resume linked in the corner, a standard CV felt redundant here. Instead, I've converted this space into a living archive, a repository for monologues, fragments, and late-night thoughts. Welcome to the journal.
